senses.definition: Old World wild swine having a narrow body and prominent tusks from which most domestic swine come; introduced in United States

latin_glosses: capio cervos, et apros, et damas, et capreas, et aliquando lepores
attestations: Coll. Monast. Th. 21, 31: Ælfc. Gr. 8; Som. 7, 14: Ps. Lamb. 79, 14

quotations.old_english: Cyng Willelm forbeád sleán ða heortas swylce eác ða báras
quotations.english: king William forbade men to kill the stags, and also the boars
